title: PROOF the source chunk autowire seeding fix enables GPS evidence retrieval once a judge promotes it
summary: Decisive verification of the source-chunk autowire seeding lane (daemon.js, commit 8e01166a). PROVEN CAUSAL CHAIN on the longmemeval-oracle GPS conv (gpt4_2655b836): (1) my lane deterministically seeds the GPS-bearing source_chunk note-mqskev3b86q#chunk-4 as a weight-0 judged:false chunk->probe candidate — identical score 0.413 across two independent ingests (run1 note id mqskev3b86q, run2 note id mqskv9vajji), eliminating the prior stochasticity AT THE SEEDING LAYER; (2) that candidate shows up in GET /judge/next for the probe (1 of 14 candidate edges, GPS chunk among them); (3) when I manually promote it via POST /judge/verdict keepEdge (simulating what a working eager-judge would do), GET /task/context for the probe THEN returns the GPS chunk as a kept dependency with weight 0.413 and the GPS evidence text — i.e. the our-way frozen-DAG arm WOULD have the answer. So the fix is correct and sufficient GIVEN a judge to promote. WHY THE BENCH STILL SHOWS 0/3: the bench isolated daemon has no usable judge backend — POST /judge/drain returns skipped:no_backend (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; the embedded daemon's claude CLI is on PATH but not authed), so weight-0 candidates are never auto-promoted; and the our-way-prod agentic search-context path does its own RAG search that does NOT consult weight-0 DAG candidates and ranks the source_chunk at ~0.044 — buried under the in-workspace probe-task self-echoes that score 1.2 — stopping after 1 round on the wrong context. All 3 limit-1 runs answered I-don't-know (0/3 GPS), deterministically (not stochastically) because of the no_backend block, not because seeding is unreliable. NET: ship the seeding fix (it is the correct, necessary building block and helps any production daemon WITH a judge backend), but it cannot move this judge-less bench's number; the remaining gap is judge-promotion availability + source_chunk search-ranking, both outside autowire's scope.
